items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 12:1
items.html: There are three pregnancies: the pregnancy of seven months, for the lights; the pregnancy of nine months, for the sparks; the pregnancy of twelve months, for the vessels. (Item 1).
